factualIntro.en: In late 380, Theodosius entered Constantinople and ordered changes in church possession. Socrates places the arrival and transfer on separate November days; Marcellinus records the restoration he favored in December. These later accounts do not establish what every inhabitant believed. The following local service story is invented.
factualIntro.es-ES: A finales de 380, Teodosio entró en Constantinopla y ordenó cambios en la posesión de iglesias. Sócrates sitúa la llegada y el traspaso en días distintos de noviembre; Marcelino fecha en diciembre la restauración que favorecía. Estos relatos posteriores no establecen qué creía cada habitante. La siguiente historia asistencial local es inventada.

factualOutro.en: Both invented local services have been completed with their original recipients. This does not explain, approve or reverse the imperial change in church possession. The next episode concerns the council of 381 and the disputes that continued.
factualOutro.es-ES: Ambos servicios locales inventados se han completado con sus destinatarios originales. Esto no explica, aprueba ni revierte el cambio imperial de posesión de iglesias. El siguiente episodio trata del concilio de 381 y de las disputas que continuaron.

dramatizationNotice.en: The local service workers, recipients, outputs, households, courts and optional activities are fictional. Their voluntary care does not cause, reverse, justify or prove the imperial change in church possession, a legal title or anyone's convictions. Marcus is a fictional clerk; no quoted speech or authentic voice is supplied.
dramatizationNotice.es-ES: Los trabajadores, destinatarios, resultados, hogares, patios y actividades secundarias asistenciales son ficticios. Su ayuda voluntaria no causa, revierte, justifica ni acredita el cambio imperial en la posesión de iglesias, un título legal o las convicciones de nadie. Marco es un escribiente ficticio; no se aportan discursos citados ni una voz auténtica.

failureRecovery.beforeCommit: Preview is free. An unaffordable confirmation changes no account. A complete reserved plan can be cancelled before irreversible commitment, refunding only its escrow; compare and reserve again.
failureRecovery.afterCommit: Costs are paid once and methods remain locked. An incorrect destination or absent recipient creates no service receipt: direct the same living original output and recipients to the selected court and obtain fresh observations. No timer substitutes for work or arrival.
failureRecovery.mainIdentityLoss: Loss of a required original recipient, loss of the selected worker before recorded work, or destruction of a genuinely generated selected output causes defeat under the existing reference rules. No free resurrection or hidden grace period is promised. A worker lost after recorded work adds no new worker-return condition.
failureRecovery.optionalIdentityLoss: Only the corresponding optional fails; no main defeat, late reward or campaign restart. Main victory closes unfinished optionals.
failureRecovery.resources: At least one complete plan remains affordable in each difficulty with all optionals skipped. Optional stock and protected recovery cannot fund the main reservation; there is no gathering, regeneration, passive income or replacement purchase in this reference design.
failureRecovery.nativeStatus: All recovery descriptions still require native input/template, save/load and game checks; reference behavior alone is not an engine implementation.
